The '''Chandrilan Security Force''' was [[Chandrila/Legends|Chandrila's]] [[Planetary Security Forces|Planetary Security Force]] throughout its history.

==History==
The Chandrilan Security Force was active during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the resurgent [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]]. During the [[Battle of the Red Reaper|Battle of the ''Red Reaper'']], The security force successfully defended the [[Chandrila Orbital Station]] with the help of an external strike team from an invasion of radical and xenophobic, rogue arm of the Sith Empire.<ref name="Red Reaper" />

The Chandrilan Security Force was still active by the time of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].<ref name="SoR" />
